targets.coverage: Noether Paper 20, Ein algebraisches Kriterium fuer absolute Irreduzibilitaet, printed pp.26-33. The audit requests one source-confirmed formula (13) correction: the two factor-sum indices should be kappa and lambda, not mu and nu. The local working TeX branch was patched accordingly and a corrected cumulative TeX copy is included under applied_fixed_tex. The audit also records that Paper 20 uses ordinary numbered footnotes, so the Paper 06-Paper 08 symbolic-footnote correction pattern should not be applied to Paper 20.
